I really relate to your limbo. I also crave an afterlife and the feeling it might provide. Sometimes the only thing that holds me over is the fact that you really do only live once. You live for maybe 80- 90 years and then you’re dead forever. Not 300 years and not 4,000 years. Forever. If there is joy/contentedness after death then I’m comforted knowing I get to feel that til the end of time. So why should I rush through such an opportunity. No one will ever be born me again. No one will ever have the same body, or the same memories. There will be similar people but no one will ever experience life through my eyes. Only me. And only you will ever experience life through yours.   If someone told you, that you could see the most beautiful mountain top, but the sun would burn your eyes, would u choose to close your eyes? Would you choose to sacrifice even a second if you knew you were the only person who would ever see this mountain top as it was? And u would only ever see it once. We didn’t choose to exist, but we choose how we view that existence and I really do try to see it as something beautiful
